acceptance: The stale-skills warning no longer appears in pr-preflight.
description:
## Problem
Every `make pr-preflight` in the run-timeout effort printed: "the primary clone's .agents/skills copy is not at the catalog revisions this branch pins in skill-sync.conf ... Agents may not refresh it. Owner: run 'make skill-sync' in /Users/joe/Developer/BenchBox." Codex, Gemini and Antigravity sessions started in the primary clone read outdated skills, and the warning was misread by an agent as a preflight failure.

## Change
Owner runs `make skill-sync` in the primary clone.

## Decision gates
Owner-only: agents must not write to the primary clone (AGENTS.md). Blocked until the owner acts.

## Verification rubric
`make pr-preflight` in any worktree no longer prints the stale-skills warning.

## Guardrails
Agents make no change in the primary clone and do not run `make skill-sync` there.
